description.zh: 要解绑关联资源的网络ACL的ID。
description.en: The ID of the network ACL that you want to disassociate from a resource.

description.zh: 要解绑的资源列表，**N**的取值为0~29，即最多可以解绑30个资源。
description.en: Resources that you want to disassociate. Valid values of **N**: 0 to 29. A maximum of 30 resources can be unbound.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens unassociate-network-acl --network-acl-id nacl-a2do9e413e0sp0000 --resource ResourceId=n-5000 ResourceType=Network --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens UnassociateNetworkAcl --region cn-hangzhou --Resource.1.ResourceId 'n-5000' --NetworkAclId 'nacl-a2do9e413e0sp0000' --Resource.1.ResourceType Network --method POST --force
